DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Suboptimal Intake Jaundice)

The history of exclusive breastfeeding every 2–3 hours without mention of adequate wet diapers or stool output, combined with the absence of dark urine or pale stools, strongly suggests insufficient milk intake leading to dehydration and reduced bilirubin excretion. I will not request further tests as the clinical picture is diagnostic.
